아가 1:1.content: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

아가 1:2.content: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.

아가 1:3.content: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

아가 1:4.content: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.

아가 1:5.content: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

아가 1:6.content: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.

아가 1:7.content: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?

아가 1:8.content: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.

아가 1:9.content: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.

아가 1:10.content: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.

아가 1:11.content: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.

아가 1:12.content: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

아가 1:13.content: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.

아가 1:14.content: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En–gedi.

아가 1:15.content: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes.

아가 1:16.content: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.

아가 1:17.content: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
